observations.scope: Four synthetic extraction requests only; not production performance or monetary cost.

recommended_next_step: Review the saved pilot outputs and amend the evaluation protocol before another live evaluation: define field-specific numeric types, clarify capture of meal/date/preference facts and scope unknown categories to each input. Preserve the original pilot and its scoring. Agree quality thresholds and a spending ceiling, then separately authorize a bounded follow-up on the same fixtures plus additional representative synthetic cases. Do not proceed to production adoption or fine-tuning on this evidence.
rationale: Four synthetic cases are diagnostic only. Publisher claims and the source-analysis run do not establish extraction performance.

evaluation_findings.finding: Dinner was omitted. The people count was expressed as the string two, which preserves its ordinary meaning but failed the evaluator integer-value comparison. The time limit was extracted but also incorrectly listed as unknown. No nuts-scope clarification was supplied.
No facts were returned, omitting dinner and the explicitly stated relative date tomorrow. No date clarification was supplied.
Both nut exclusion and walnut inclusion were retained, with a contradiction flag and clarification question. This passed the recorded deterministic checks.
The meaning of light was queried, but dinner and the original preference expression were not retained as facts.

evaluator_limitations: The schema permits string or integer values generically; the scorer expects an integer for people_count. Therefore the string two is flagged as changed/missing even though it preserves the stated quantity semantically. This is a representation mismatch, not evidence of an invented people count.
All outputs listed every unknown category. The checks detect a known time limit incorrectly marked unknown, but do not exhaustively score irrelevant unknown categories.
Quality checks use a conservative saved lexical rubric, not independent semantic verification. Four single runs supply no statistical reliability estimate or comparison with the existing application.
No scoring rule or request parameter was changed after observing this pilot; original outputs and findings remain unchanged.
